mapper.sql: SELECT REST_NO , REST_NAME , CATEGORY , MIN_PRICE , DELIVERY_FEE FROM RESTAURANT
mapper.select:
WHERE CATEGORY LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY REST_NO
SELECT MENU_NO , REST_NO , MENU_NAME , PRICE , SOLD_OUT , MIN_PRICE , DELIVERY_FEE , REST_NAME FROM MENU JOIN RESTAURANT USING(REST_NO) WHERE REST_NO = #{restNo} ORDER BY MENU_NO
